findings.reason: as written a node would build an already-shipped cycle-breaker, and the review of the run that requested it cannot even be reproduced at base.
findings.text: s11 says "the review cannot be filed without the waived delta, and the waiver cannot be recorded without a filed review", but at base `_record_suite_delta_waiver` (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3578, called at :3995 before any promotion check) writes the waiver onto the run's pointer on the completion request itself and its docstring says so ("including a request the promotion then refuses: ... the reviewer needs the waiver in hand before the landing that would record it can succeed"), while the cited `crew repair --review` refusal "repaired review remains unfileable: missing or invalid added_failure_count" is the null-count branch at reckon/crew/review.py:1287, not the no-waiver branch, so the quoted evidence cannot show the cycle it is offered to prove

findings.reason: an ambiguous base arm either measures nothing or measures the store rather than §11's endpoint, so the node's whole gate rests on it.
findings.text: the negative control asserts that at base case (a) is refused with "no review of the promoted revision is stored" or "missing or invalid added_failure_count", but on a run never completed before a review record carrying the waived count is refused when it is stored by `waived_failure_count_refusals` (reckon/crew/review.py:1324) for having no recorded waiver, so the arm fails in the test's setup rather than at either named refusal, and once the record is merely delivered the same completion call records the waiver at request time before the review check runs, so case (a) may pass at base with no control left

findings.reason: both upstream sections are declared `done` and landed, so the missing wait changes no dispatch or gate today.
findings.text: the section-declarations map moves s11 to `implementable` but `plan-section-depends-on` still carries only `{"s10":["a-gate-halts-only-on-substance#s9"]}`, so §11's dependence on the §9/§10 waived-form mechanism is nowhere declared

response_events.note: right: the waiver is recorded on the completion request before any check, so filing works after a first refused completion, which is how nova filed its waived review; §11 is rewritten around the defect nova hit next, a completion that raises TypeError in normalized_suite_observation on an arm with a null count
